stages.title: Synthetic native foundation
stages.scope: Frozen native shell and synthetic HP, message and key-request foundation.

stages.title: Pregame baseline
stages.scope: Frozen transport, connection, authentication and pregame character-entry baseline.

stages.title: Packaged client launch
stages.scope: Launch an installed SV client; optional platform integrations remain deferred.

stages.title: Settings bootstrap
stages.scope: Load, default and parse setting data without exposing the settings UI.

stages.title: Core file and resource data
stages.scope: Resource overlays, history, DNA, notes, export collision handling and transient ownership.

stages.title: Preference loading
stages.scope: Load and bootstrap preference files; macro precedence remains deferred.

stages.title: Gameplay input primitives
stages.scope: Keymap, quantity and raw-key handling on top of the Stage B input baseline.

stages.title: Text and map fonts
stages.scope: Load, select and fall back between text and map fonts.

stages.title: Game rendering
stages.scope: Complete visual rendering, including visual weather but excluding audio playback.

stages.title: Remaining network control flows
stages.scope: Complete packet and control outcomes beyond the Stage B transport baseline.

stages.title: Startup Lua reload
stages.scope: Reload transferred Lua data needed by startup.

stages.title: Server file transfer
stages.scope: Check, initialize, transfer, complete and upload server files.

stages.title: Session preparation
stages.scope: Prepare profile input, startup transfer, live identity and redraw before play.

stages.title: Live character status
stages.scope: Complete live HUD and character status on top of Stage A HP.

stages.title: Live game map data
stages.scope: Receive and present the main live game map.

stages.title: Live session lifecycle
stages.scope: Enter play, reconnect, portal relogin and quit.

stages.title: Overview map and locate
stages.scope: Floor, world and neighbouring-panel overview navigation.

stages.title: Live and historical messages
stages.scope: Live feed, recall and important-message views.

stages.title: Server requests
stages.scope: Amount, number, string and confirmation requests beyond Stage A.

stages.title: Targeting and inspection
stages.scope: Select targets and inspect entities and ground grids.

stages.title: Direction selection
stages.scope: Choose, cancel and answer direction interactions.

stages.title: World movement and interaction
stages.scope: Movement, rest, search, stairs and adjacent-feature actions.

stages.title: Inventory data and item-selection surfaces
stages.scope: Inventory, equipment, bag and floor state; item selection, newest markers, server item replies, item-detail surfaces, list close/paste behavior and update-time auto-inscription.

stages.title: Ordinary item actions
stages.scope: Pickup, dropping, equipment changes, inscriptions, consumables, devices, stacking, bag transfer and inspection; spell-dependent activation remains deferred.

stages.title: Skills and abilities
stages.scope: Read and navigate skills and select abilities.

stages.title: Spells and special abilities
stages.scope: Spell metadata, books, schools, casting and activation flows.

stages.title: Spell-dependent item actions
stages.scope: Activation, selected-item use and server spell selection.

stages.title: Combat actions
stages.scope: Firing, throwing, stealing and other combat actions.

stages.title: Ordinary stores
stages.scope: Ordinary stock, transactions and item views without the aggregated service outcome.

stages.title: Chat
stages.scope: Send, cancel and review chat, including item substitution.

stages.title: Data export
stages.scope: Export character and message data.

stages.title: Information surfaces
stages.scope: Sheets, history, lore, notes, lag and live-player information.

stages.title: Documents
stages.scope: Read, navigate, search, refresh and close document surfaces.

stages.title: End-of-session flows
stages.scope: Death, tomb, final review, suicide and final-scene transitions.

stages.title: Housing
stages.scope: House ownership, access, trade and painting.

stages.title: Special-store presentation
stages.scope: Special-store text, glyphs, slots, wheel, dice, cards and wager state.

stages.title: Server-driven gameplay flows
stages.scope: Casino, mail, repair, donation, ownership and quest sequences.

stages.title: Store services
stages.scope: Aggregated store services after server-driven flows.

stages.title: Credential updates
stages.scope: Persist a changed credential before account password-management flows.

stages.title: Account management
stages.scope: Account information and password changes on top of Stage B authentication.

stages.title: Character ordering
stages.scope: Swap, insert and append characters and cancel reorder flows.

stages.title: Birth DNA persistence
stages.scope: Restore and save birth choices after Stage B creation.

stages.title: Administration
stages.scope: Complete administration command and surface block.

stages.title: Clipboard
stages.scope: Copy, paste, extract URLs and report failures.

stages.title: Party and guild interaction
stages.scope: Party, iron-team, guild and hostility flows.

stages.title: Settings interface
stages.scope: Saving, preview, layout, scale, panels, widgets and palette settings.

stages.title: Input, messages and alert options
stages.scope: Key, macro and store-context toggles; incoming-message presentation; paging and warning behavior.

stages.title: HUD, lighting and visibility options
stages.scope: Numeric and status-bar presentation, overview and player lists, map lighting and remembered visibility.

stages.title: Map identity, animation, movement and targeting options
stages.scope: Glyph and player identity, animation, weather, color, running, disturbance, easy interaction and targeting behavior.

stages.title: Item handling and session options
stages.scope: Item naming, stacking, inscriptions, autoloot, selection and idle, death and session-return behavior.

stages.title: Audio and client-integration options
stages.scope: Paging and audio mixing, music selection and resume, pacing, screenshot naming, OS beep suppression and clone outputs.

stages.title: Game alerts
stages.scope: HP, mana, sanity, page and warning-beep alerts.

stages.title: Legacy import
stages.scope: Offer, reconcile, commit and repeat legacy-data import.

stages.title: Macro preference precedence
stages.scope: Define macro-file precedence before the macro runtime.

stages.title: Macro input runtime
stages.scope: Macro matching, wait and extended-wait input behavior.

stages.title: Macro management
stages.scope: Inspect, create, edit, record, stage, load and save macros.

stages.title: Audio
stages.scope: Sounds, music, weather, ambient audio, packs and mixing.

stages.title: Editable client configuration
stages.scope: Identity, endpoint, rendering and audio configuration.

stages.title: Optional platform capabilities
stages.scope: Optional image, archive, download, sticky and gameplay integrations.

stages.title: Local Lua execution
stages.scope: Optional local Lua execution.

stages.title: Shared INS files
stages.scope: Shared INS-file handling.

stages.title: Operating-system integration
stages.scope: Open URLs and local files through the operating system.

stages.title: Screenshots
stages.scope: Capture, server-triggered capture and opening the latest image.

stages.title: Guide core
stages.scope: Read, navigate, search, update, copy, paste and use help without bookmarks.

stages.title: Guide bookmark persistence
stages.scope: Load and save Guide bookmarks.

stages.title: Guide bookmarks
stages.scope: Create, open and delete Guide bookmarks.
